title: Möbius-Strip Crosswords
summary: A creative blog post exploring the concept of designing crossword puzzles on a Möbius strip surface, where words wrap around and connect in non-traditional ways due to the topological properties of the one-sided strip.
problem_solved: Explores the creative challenge of adapting traditional 2D crossword puzzles to work on a non-orientable 3D surface with unique connectivity rules.
why_valuable: Demonstrates an interesting intersection of mathematics (topology), puzzles, and creative problem-solving that appeals to both math enthusiasts and puzzle designers.
